bias.en: Downtrend · oversold bounce, back above $55, under the 5-day
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 超卖反弹，重回 $55 上方，低于 5 日均线

read.en: Intel rose 1.9% on Nov 19 to $55.72, trading $54.85–59.44. It is just under the 5-day ($56.1) and below the 10-day ($57.8), 30-day ($76.3) and 100-day ($95.1), all falling, and the 200-day ($87.5, rising). MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 18, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($68.28), and RSI is 31.0.
read.zh: 英特尔 11月19日上涨 1.9%，收于 $55.72，盘中区间 $54.85–59.44。股价略低于 5 日均线（$56.1），并位于 10 日（$57.8）、30 日（$76.3）和 100 日均线（$95.1）下方，三者均在下行，也低于 200 日均线（$87.5，上行）。MACD 于 11月18日上穿信号线，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$68.28），RSI 为 31.0。

read.en: The close reclaimed $54.9–55.5 (Nov 16 low and close), now support, but the $59.44 high faded back under the 10-day. Resistance is $56–56.3 (5-day, Nov 18 high, Nov 6 close), then $57.8–58.1 (10-day, Nov 10 close) and $59.4–59.7 (Nov 19 high, Nov 9 and 13 closes). Support is $54.6–54.9, then $52.25–53.4 and $51.5 (Nov 5 low). A close above $56.3 would target $58; below $54.56, $52.25–53.4.
